title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 42 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 42)

content.overview: Section 42 provides a jurisdictional rule where an application under Part I has been made in a Court. Once such an application is made in a competent Court, that Court alone has jurisdiction over subsequent applications arising out of that agreement and the arbitral proceedings, subject to the statutory scope of the provision.
